description: Landings through scripts/land.sh, builds, agents, issues and releases of Shale (node_exporter textfile metrics from scripts/dev-metrics.sh).

panels.title: Landing state
panels.description: Whether a landing currently holds the land.sh lock.

panels.title: Queue waiting
panels.description: land.sh processes waiting for the lock.

panels.title: Current landing age
panels.description: How long the running landing has been going.

panels.title: Current step age
panels.description: How long the current landing step has been running.

panels.title: Time since last success
panels.description: Time since the last landing with result landed.

panels.title: Success rate in range
panels.description: Share of landings in the selected time range that ended landed.

panels.title: Current branch and step
panels.description: Branch and step of the running landing (empty when idle).

panels.title: Last landing
panels.description: Branch, result and failed step of the last finished landing.

panels.title: Landings in range by result
panels.description: Landings in the selected time range per result.

panels.title: Collector staleness
panels.description: Seconds since the collector last wrote shale.prom.

panels.title: Source OK
panels.description: Whether the last fetch of each source (github, forgejo, git) worked.

panels.title: Source age
panels.description: Age of the cached data of each source.

panels.title: Average landing duration
panels.description: Average duration of landings finished in the last hour, per result.

panels.title: Landings per hour
panels.description: Landings finished per hour by result.

panels.title: Queue and running
panels.description: Landings waiting for the lock and whether one is running.

panels.title: Load at landing end
panels.description: 1-minute load average at the end of the last landing.

panels.title: Average step duration
panels.description: Average duration of each landing step over all recorded landings.

panels.title: Last step duration
panels.description: Duration of each step in the last landing that ran it.

panels.title: Failures by step
panels.description: Landings that failed at each step in the selected range.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Load 1/5/15 against the CPU count (dashed line).

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle.

panels.title: Memory

panels.title: Pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time tasks stalled on CPU and IO (empty when PSI is not exported).
